title: Pointwise colimits of sections of a cocartesian fibration
statement: Use quasicategories, universes, coherent functors, full subcategories, weak contractibility and colimits as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and cocartesian fibrations and fibers as in [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $p:\mathcal E\to\mathcal B$ be a cocartesian fibration of quasicategories and $g:T\to\mathcal B$ a map from a small simplicial set. For an edge $f:b\to b'$, write $f_!:\mathcal E_b\to\mathcal E_{b'}$ for transport by cocartesian lifts. Let $K$ be a small weakly contractible simplicial set. Suppose every fiber admits $K$-indexed colimits and every $f_!$ preserves them. Define $\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathcal B}(T,\mathcal E)$ to be the fiber over $g$ of postcomposition $\operatorname{Fun}(T,\mathcal E)\to\operatorname{Fun}(T,\mathcal B)$. This category admits $K$-indexed colimits, and a cocone in it is colimiting if and only if evaluation at each vertex $t$ is a colimit cocone in $\mathcal E_{g(t)}$. For any specified set $H$ of edges of $T$, the full subcategory of functors carrying every edge of $H$ to a $p$-cocartesian edge is closed under these colimits.

source.place: Gepner-Haugseng, Enriched infinity-categories via nonsymmetric infinity-operads, Theorem A.5.3 (i)-(iii), with Lemma A.5.2 for (iii); read online. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical theorem.
